newsitem.title: KENYA: Three killed in attack on Kenyan slum - residents.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in attack on Kenyan slum - residents.

text.p: Three men were killed in a night raid on a slum north of Kenya's Indian Ocean port of Mombasa, residents said on Sunday.
The attack brought to 28 the death toll in a series of attacks by unidentified assailants armed with knives, machetes and clubs in the Mombasa area.
The three men killed in the overnight attack were from western Kenya. Dozens of people were wounded in the attack.
Residents said leaflets found in the area on Saturday night warned "foreigners" from other Kenyan areas to quit the coast.
They said locals ran to tell the police in a nearby station about the raid but the police did not respond.
About 40 homes in the Shauri Yako slum, eight km (five miles) from Mombasa, were burned down by the raiders.
In Mombasa town, the situation was quiet but tense overnight, residents reported. All the attacks, which began on Wednesday night, have taken place in areas on the outskirts of the port town.
